description: This PHP source file manages product addition, display, and deletion within an e-commerce admin panel. It includes functionalities to add new products with images, validate inputs, interact with the database, and handle image uploads and deletions.
external_methods: move_uploaded_file: PHP function to move uploaded images
unlink: PHP function to delete images

methods.name: add_product
methods.description: Handles the process of adding a new product, including sanitizing input data, checking for existing products, inserting into the database, and uploading images.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a product, removes associated images, and deletes related records from cart and wishlist tables.
